scope: Domain-neutral AC-WM long-action agentic skill validation
summary: The skill was generalized from flower-specific routing to public Ego scenes and passed the official quick validator plus SkillHone offline static checks using an isolated PyYAML tool path.
evidence: agentic_skills/acwm-long-action-control/SKILL.md now routes public Ego bottle tasks without flower-scene defaults.
The official generator produced agents/openai.yaml, quick_validate.py passed, and SkillHone static_check.py passed.
PyYAML was installed only under /tmp/phiagent-skill-deps.QKiEGV and was not added to the import-time PhiAgent dependency set.
lessons: An isolated tool dependency preserves the package's CPU-light import contract while allowing complete skill metadata validation.
